title: Console, command line and declared infrastructure: three doors, one API

videos.script: The console, the command line and Terraform are three doors into one room. Behind each is the same API. {{doors}} You will create three topics through three doors, and read what each one sent. gcloud, curl, and Terraform with its debug log. {{three}} The same PUT to the same kind of address, every time. Terraform then reads the resource back, and that read is the difference. {{read}} Because a plan reads first, it notices drift: a change someone made through another door. {{drift}} Delete a topic with gcloud, and Terraform says it has been deleted. Plan again, and it puts it back. {{back}} The files decide. Whoever uses another door has to change the files too, or see the change undone. {{files}} So each door gets its own work. The console to look. gcloud to do one thing now. Terraform for anything that should exist tomorrow. {{end}}
